{{Quote|Now, assemble your warriors and your medic at the edge of town and go find Attichitcuk.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca and his party|audio=TU4-WNARN-L46.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] constructed a '''base''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] as part of a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonial war]] fought against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. It was established for the purpose of training [[bowcaster trooper]]s to combat the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. The base also had access to multiple sources of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], which were harvested to support the Wookiee forces. When the [[Colonist/Legends|colony's]] leader, [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], was [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|badly wounded]] by the Trade Federation's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], his [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], led a party of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] from the base on a [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue mission]]. After the party returned to the base with Attichitcuk, the Trade Federation sent three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] there in an attack that was unsuccessful.

==Description==
{{Quote|If you build a Food Processing Center close to a source of food, your workers won't have to walk as far to deliver their food.|Qui-Gon Jinn, advising the Wookiees to expand the base|audio=HowToFood.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:A_river_runs.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The river next to the base]]
During the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] workers constructed a base&mdash;one of several on the moon&mdash;surrounded by a [[Water/Legends|river]] that flowed around the northern and eastern borders of the settlement. The base was also near a [[Tree/Legends|forest]] and had plentiful sources of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], including [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit bushes]]; wild animals such as [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] and [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]]; and [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the river.<ref name="GB" />

When the base was first built, it contained four structures&mdash;a [[command center]], a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] for training [[bowcaster trooper]]s, a [[prefab shelter]] for housing the Wookiees, and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]] to provide energy to each building. Following [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] recommendations, more buildings were constructed at the base, including<ref name="GB" /> two [[food processing center]]s<ref name="Prima" /> near the muja [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]], multiple [[Farm/Legends|farms]], an [[animal nursery]],<ref name="GB" /> and enough prefab shelters to house at least eighteen Wookiees.<ref name="Prima" /> Two [[marker]]s were placed at the north-western edge of the base as a rallying point for the Wookiee [[Troop/Legends|troops]].<ref name="GB" />

==History==
===Food and defense===
{{Quote|We are in no position to challenge the Trade Federation army. For now, we will concentrate on defending ourselves if they challenge us.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the colonists at the base|audio=TU4-WNARN-L09.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Food_center_build.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The construction of the first food processing center]]
The base was constructed<ref name="GB" /> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> during the colonization of Alaris Prime by a [[Alaris Prime colonists|group]] of Wookiees. Following an [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|encounter]] with the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], which sought to [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegally]] claim the moon, the Wookiees' [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], Qui-Gon Jinn, was motivated to help train more [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in preparation for [[Alaris Prime colonial war|further conflict]]. While the colony's leader, [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], went to investigate the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] activities, Jinn began guiding a group of eight Wookiees at the base. These included four workers, three [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], and Attichitcuk's [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Their goals were to train more soldiers for defense and upgrade the [[technology level]] of the colonists.<ref name="GB" />

Jinn first showed the Wookiees how to strengthen the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of their workers, before instructing them to gather muja fruit from the nearby bushes. The workers built a food processing center in close proximity to the bushes to store food more efficiently, which also allowed for the creation of farms.<ref name="GB" /> While exploring the base's surroundings, one of the bowcaster troopers<ref name="Prima" /> found a herd of nerfs to the south. In response, Jinn had a worker construct an animal nursery to put the creatures to use.<ref name="GB" /> A second food processing center was also built near another crop of fruit bushes to the southwest after the initial ones were picked dry.<ref name="Prima" />

===Battlegrounds===
{{Quote|I sense another attack coming. Gather your forces and be ready.|Qui-Gon Jinn's warning to the Wookiees at the base|audio=AttackSensed.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Revenge_at_base.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The base under attack by droidekas]]
Once a certain threshold of food was reached, the Wookiees made advancements in their technology, and around this [[Time/Legends|time]] Attichitcuk was [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|ambushed]] and nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s of the Trade Federation. Jinn sensed the [[Chief/Legends|chieftain's]] survival through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and had the Wookiees assemble a [[Unidentified Wookiee medical droid|medical droid]] at the base's command center in preparation for a [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue mission]].<ref name="GB" />

Once up to ten bowcaster troopers were ready,<ref name="Prima" /> with stronger armor as a result of the increased technology level, Chewbacca gathered them and the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] at the base's markers and set out to save Attichitcuk.<ref name="GB" /> In their absence, at least two more bowcaster troopers<ref name="Prima" /> were trained at the base's troop center in case of any further Trade Federation attacks. As Chewbacca's party journeyed back to the base with Attichitcuk, the extra troopers set out to meet them, helping to destroy a group of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. At the base, Attichitcuk was immediately sent to the command center to recover, and shortly afterward the Trade Federation [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[DRN-38]] sent three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] to attack the base, which were defeated by the Wookiees.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You'll need 500 food and two buildings from your current tech level to advance to a new technology level.|Qui-Gon Jinn, instructing the player to expand the base|audio=500food.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The Wookiee base was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> It features in the fourth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, entitled "Researching Technology."<ref name="GB" />

The base starts out with only four buildings, and the player is only able to add more power cores, prefab shelters, food processing centers, animal nurseries, and troop centers. Any two of these buildings along with 500 units of food are required before the player's technology level can be upgraded, which is necessary to progress through the game.<ref name="GB" />
